protocol.sensory_measurements: Computed locally from the fixed graph on demand; shared across arms only to avoid identical simulation work. No prior run cache.
protocol.budget_comparison: Frozen same-fly potential outcomes; batch allocation by unlabeled context, not an online quota implementation.
protocol.threshold_baseline: Training-only median of observed decision margins, fixed during test.

supplementary_protocol.purpose: Check whether acquisition differences survive exact training and test inspection-budget matching, and compare a fixed left crop.
supplementary_protocol.matched_random: Three random permutations of each Core training/test inspection mask; only the inspection counts are transferred, never labels, rewards, features, weights or decisions.
supplementary_protocol.fixed_left_always: Fresh fly readout, always inspect the left crop; no adaptive controller.
supplementary_protocol.task_state: Fresh per arm. Reuse only fixed sensory measurements generated during the current comparison.
